references.text: Describes false leaders as greedy dogs and evil shepherds, parallel to the warning about false prophets in Matt 7:15.
Warns against leaders who behave like predators toward the people, similar to the image of wolves in Matt 7:15.
Warns against false prophets and their destruction, parallel to the warning in Matt 7:15.
Warns against false teachers who will infiltrate with destructive heresies, parallel to the warning in Matt 7:15.
